waste-classification.title: AI Powered Autonomous Waste Classification
waste-classification.description: An ongoing, sustainability-focused machine learning research project that integrates computer vision with Large Language Models (LLMs) to classify recyclable waste on industrial conveyor belts in real time with high accuracy.

skin-detect.title: Skin Detect Application and CNN Model
skin-detect.description: An edge computing powered mobile diagnostic app capable of detecting over 20 dermatological conditions in milliseconds. Trained on 20,000+ medical images using PyTorch and Ultralytics YOLO.

barwise.title: Barwise: Social Cocktail Recipe
barwise.description: A social recipe-sharing application featuring a rich UI/UX, built with Dart and Flutter. It leverages asynchronous data streams and modern state management architectures for seamless performance.

moviesync.title: MovieSync
moviesync.description: A dynamic movie and tv show tracking platform that allows users to build personalized movie and tv show libraries via modern API integrations, synchronize their watch histories, and manage their content.

hotel-scraper.title: Hotel Scraper
hotel-scraper.description: An automated data mining tool built with Python and BeautifulSoup to extract hotel metadata from Booking.com. Unstructured data is cleaned, processed, and presented through a user-friendly graphical interface.
